hypothesis: Suppressing low-value clarification when healthy Top-K results are highly stable and no useful Candidate partition exists will reduce wasted questions and MTTC without reducing HitRate.

candidate_rule.ask: Preserve the existing question when evidence is unavailable/degraded, a useful available Candidate partition exists, or stability is unavailable/below 0.8.
candidate_rule.do_not_ask: Healthy candidate_stability >= 0.8 and no useful partition among currently available attributes.

question_measurement.reason: The retained evaluator report does not contain turn-level ask_attribute or clarification-reason traces.
question_measurement.future_requirement: Any renewed A9 experiment must retain a hash-bound turn audit before claiming question-count or no-value-question improvement.

simulator_mechanism: Recommendations are scored before the next customer reply. Asking does not delay a same-turn hit; on a miss, ask_attribute=null causes a generic request for a specific question rather than revealing a target preference. Suppression can therefore remove future constraint evidence without improving the current turn.
fold_status: not run because the primary Development-160 candidate regressed HitRate, MRR, MTTC, Efficiency, and technical score
keep_gate: MTTC/Efficiency improves on stable folds, HitRate does not materially fall, and question/no-value counts fall.
